info.name: Synapse AI - Backend APIs (Production Ready 100/100)
info.description:
Production-grade, 100% User ID based API Collection for Synapse AI Android backend.

Key Highlights:
- Zero token overhead (Direct, clean User ID architecture)
- Modular relational tables (users, user_profiles, user_settings, user_achievements, user_notifications)
- Automated test validation scripts with assertions on every endpoint
- Complete example responses for seamless offline inspection
- 1-to-1 mapping with Synapse AI Android mobile screens

item.name: 1. Authentication & Security
item.description: Handles User Registration, Multi-method Login (User ID, Phone), and Direct Password Reset.

request.description:
Android Screen: RegisterScreen
Creates new user in `users`, initializes default profile in `user_profiles`, default settings in `user_settings`, and seeds 8 starter achievements.
